Self-attention among records with doubly stochastic weights

Source: R/attention.R
refine_moments.Rd

Replaces each transmitted moment by an average of all of them, \(\tilde M_j = \sum_h A_{jh} M_h\), with \(A = D K D\), \(K_{jh} = \exp\{tr(P_j P_h)/(k\tau)\}\) and \(D\) diagonal, found by Sinkhorn iterations so that every row and column of \(A\) sums to one. Because \(K\) is symmetric, so is \(A\): each record gives as much weight as it receives, and no record dominates the refined set. The receiver can do this with what it holds.

Usage

refine_moments(moments, k, tau, iters = 500L)

Arguments

moments

A list of bp_moment objects.

k

Dimension of the projectors.

tau

Temperature.

iters

Maximum number of Sinkhorn iterations.

Value

A list of bp_moment objects of the same rank, with the matrix A in the attribute A.

Examples

sim <- simulate_beats(H = 5, n = 60, p = 20, q = 3, seed = 6)
m <- lapply(sim$X, energy_moment, q = 5)
r <- refine_moments(m, k = 3, tau = 0.05)
round(colSums(attr(r, "A")), 6)
#> [1] 1 1 1 1 1
